intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “A merchant just told his friend that their meeting went swimmingly.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Was the meeting held in a current? Were there eels?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Well? Half of swimming is not drowning. The other half is eels.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Up on the walkway, the merchant is still telling people how swimmingly it went.

options.labelText: “So we took your hardest skill and made it mean ‘fine’?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Without asking. I am drafting a complaint.”

options.labelText: “To be fair, swimming must be pretty easy for you.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Easy the way stairs are easy for you.”
